title: KubeCon 2026 - travel & expenses scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for KubeCon 2026 travel admin + expense reminders (notes to self).

Overview:
- Conference: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon 2026 (San Diego)
- Dates on site: 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-12
- My travel dates: fly out 2026-03-08 (evening), return 2026-03-13 (afternoon)
- Purpose: speak on platform autoscaling + customer meetings / partner dinners

Bookings (booked via TripActions):
- Flight: UA 789 (SFO -> SAN), depart 2026-03-08 18:15, arrive 20:10. Return UA 790 (SAN -> SFO) 2026-03-13 14:45. PNR: ABCD123
- Hotel: Marriott Marquis San Diego Marina, 2026-03-08 -> 2026-03-13, confirmation 987654321
- Ground: Lyft to/from airport + hotel (save receipts). Prebooked hotel shuttle? check arrival instructions.

Vendor / travel support contacts:
- TripActions customer success (expedite changes): support@tripactions.com, +1-888-555-1212 (portal ref AB-2026-37)
- Marriott group contact: Rachel Gomez, r.gomez@marriott.com, +1-619-555-0199 (booking ref Redwood Inference block)
- Conference logistics (badges / speaker desk): kubecon-support@cncf.io (ask about speaker check-in window)

Checklist (high priority):
- [ ] Upload all digital receipts to TripActions within 7 days of each expense
- [ ] Mark personal vs company expenses on each receipt (meals with family/plus-one => personal)
- [ ] Submit expense report in Concur (or Expensify?) — finance prefers Concur link on travel page
- [ ] Expense deadline: must submit by 2026-03-31 to be included in March payroll reimbursement
- [ ] Put receipts for dinners with partners as "business entertainment" and include attendee names/companies and purpose
- [ ] Add per-diem note for meals if I go over company card (follow policy)
- [ ] Confirm rental/ride invoices if used (Uber/Lyft) and attach trip IDs

Expense categories & quick guidance:
- Flights: company-paid (economy; upgrades must be pre-approved). Add boarding passes + e-ticket screenshot.
- Hotel: company-paid; incidentals personal unless pre-approved. Tip receipts are personal.
- Meals: company will reimburse up to policy limits or use per-diem. For multi-attendee meals, capture attendee list and business purpose.
- Ground transport: reimburse with receipt. If no receipt (shared ride), screenshot app trip detail.
- Misc: exhibitor swag? need approval if > $500.

Receipts handling / submission notes:
- Save PDFs and original email confirmations. TripActions stores most automatically but verify each match.
- For physical receipts (taxi tips, coffee) take photo immediately and upload to TripActions mobile.
- For shared meals, create a single expense line and list attendees in the "notes" field.
- Currency: all charges will be in USD; if expense in local currency, include conversion (TripActions usually provides).

Onsite logistics / meetings:
- Speaker slot: 2026-03-10, 11:30am, room B3. Need laptop HDMI adapter (bring dongle + backup).
- Speaker dinner: 2026-03-09, 7:00pm (by invite) — company will cover. Save receipt and list attendees.
- Customer dinner: 2026-03-10, 8:00pm at The Fishery — company-paid, bring business cards.
- Team meetup: quick standup 2026-03-09 morning outside expo hall (confirm exact time)

Notes to self / rough timeline:
- 2026-02-15: confirm final slide deck + speaker bio to events team (DONE)
- 2026-02-20: RSVP to speaker dinner (pending)
- 2026-02-25: check hotel check-in policy (early arrival note)
- 2026-03-08: carry printed boarding pass backup (rare, but do it)
- 2026-03-13: submit expense report draft in Concur before boarding if possible

Questions / unresolved items (follow up):
- Do we have a company card for booth incidentals? who is the card custodian for the booth? (ask Jamie)
- Are partner dinner costs (team + partners) billed to company cc or reimbursed later? clarify with Ops/Finance.
- Confirm whether Marriott will charge incidental hold on company card — finance needs pre-approval if so.

Useful links & refs:
- Redwood travel policy (meals, per-diem, receipts): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/FIN/Travel+Expense+Policy
- TripActions booking page (my trip): https://tripactions.com/booking/ABCD-1234
- KubeCon speaker page / check-in: https://events.linuxfoundation.org/kubecon + speaker desk email: kubecon-support@cncf.io

Quick tips (less formal):
- Keep a single Google Photos album with all receipt photos for quick access.
- If splitting receipts with partner, note exact amounts in expense note to avoid back-and-forth.
- When in doubt, over-document: attendee names, business purpose, and context. Finance hates ambiguity.

If anything changes (flight time, hotel), update TripActions and drop a note in #travel-redwood Slack.

End of scratchpad — will prune to formal expense report template after the trip.
